title: Efficient adsorption of 1,4-naphthoquinone on covalent organic frameworks
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,1463-1470
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01025J, Paper
Yiting Wang, Jing Pan, Fan Xia
Three covalent organic frameworks are developed for the adsorption of 1,4-naphthoquinone, which moderately toxic and can cause serious pollution of water, soil, and air.
